title: Large Teppanyaki Grill Table Electric Hot Plate Bbq Griddle Camping 1500W
body_html:
Description:

-The anti-skid bracket design can keep the oven away from the table top, maintain high heat dissipation performance, and won't damage the table top when grilling.

-The induction rod adopts vacuum design, which can conduct electricity more rapidly and the induction is more sensitive.



Feature:

- Size: 68 x 28 x 8.5cm. (Suitable for 4-6 persons use.)

- Voltage: 220V.

- Power: 1500W.

- Working Temperature:100-240℃.

- With temperature control design, the gear can be selected as needed,the automatic power-off design in each gear that can prevent the food from being baked bad.

- Both the baking tray and the fish tray have coated surfaces, safe, non-toxic, eco-friendly, non-stick, easy to clean.

- Anti-skid bracket design can keep the oven away from the table top.

- Premium heating tube can effectively gather energy and conduct heat quickly.

- power plug all can be separated from the oven base, making it clean easily.



Package Include:

1 X Electric Table Top Grill
